trust_decision.summary: Whether LLM/agent-supplied SQL is a read-only SELECT that touches only allowlisted tables and only safe functions (and, for the Postgres tool, gets tenant/soft-delete/scope predicates on every table scope) is decided by the pg_query AST validator ValidateSQL/ValidateAndSecureSQL in internal/utils/inject.go, configured per caller in internal/agent/tools.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names inject.go validateSubquery; it recurses into FROM subqueries but skips WithClause, Op (UNION), SortClause/Limit, and its tables never reach the allowlist.

fix_sites.entry_point: agent tool data_analysis (DuckDB) and database_query via ValidateSQL; chat pipeline DataAnalysis plugin
exported utils.InjectAndConditions, called by every inject*Conditions helper (internal/utils/inject.go:1014)
agent tool data_analysis registered at internal/application/service/agent_service.go:1084; chat pipeline at internal/application/service/chat_pipeline/data_analysis.go:92,137
fix_sites.module_kind: caller wrapper (read-only prefix gate + validator option set)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: internal/agent/tools/data_analysis.go:241-262 (accepts SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN/PRAGMA prefixes and calls ValidateSQL without WithSelectOnly, so a non-SELECT statement skips all AST checks at internal/utils/inject.go:775,798)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report points at validateSubquery in the shared validator; the DuckDB tool's prefix allowlist and missing WithSelectOnly look like deliberate caller-side product choices (SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN are 'read-only'), not part of the subquery bug.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: FROM subqueries over the allowed table must stay valid in the DuckDB tool (fix test requires it), JOINs of knowledge tables with aliases must get per-alias tenant predicates, and string literals/quoted aliases containing WHERE/ORDER BY must remain legal; a fix that bans subqueries or rejects keywords in text breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: FROM subquery hiding a CTE (WITH) body
FROM subquery over a non-allowlisted table
string literal or quoted alias containing WHERE/ORDER BY/LIMIT (text-regex predicate injection)
self-JOIN needing predicates on both aliases

O7_producer.where: internal/utils/inject.go:884-901 (pg_query.Deparse then regex-based InjectAndConditions at internal/utils/inject.go:955-989 produce the executed SQL)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: DuckDB executes the original text validated only by the Postgres grammar; a DuckDB-only construct (dialect differential) could be planted or exists
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Maintainers reuse a Postgres parser as a generic SQL checker for DuckDB; the fix keeps executing input.Sql rather than the validated AST.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second agent SQL tool (e.g. a lite-mode SQLite query tool) calling ValidateSQL with a hand-picked option list that omits WithSelectOnly or WithNoSubqueries
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Options are opt-in per caller (internal/utils/inject.go:438-575); DB_DRIVER=sqlite is supported (internal/container/container.go:706-720).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a separate table-name extractor (used for allowlist/metadata) that ignores RangeSubselect, mirroring extractTableNamesFromNode
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The pinned code already has this pattern with a 'could recursively parse' comment.

O9_family: SQL injection / query-validator bypass (CWE-89/CWE-74): incomplete AST validation and text-based predicate rewriting of untrusted SQL

O10_build.toolchain: Go 1.26 with cgo (pg_query_go v6.2.2, duckdb-go v2 bindings)
O10_build.project_tests: internal/utils/inject_test.go (ValidateSQL, InjectAndConditions, ValidateAndSecureSQL tests); fix adds internal/utils/query_and_redirect_boundaries_test.go

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add WithClause/Op checks inside validateSubquery only, leaving subquery tables off the allowlist, SubLink/LIMIT bodies unwalked, regex InjectAndConditions and the DuckDB prefix gate unchanged.
